title: Present and reveal Finder keyboard selection
description: Source @3e44338f53906c23e54fc747a3d689a5d7e0ee2a: os/flair/finder_windows.c:2203-2216 mutates selection, reveals only WSCROLL_V and invalidates; os/milton/kmain.c:7530-7550 dispatches an ordinary Finder key without draining damage/content and presenting. The switch helper returns for unchanged foreground at :1713; disk-tenant service at :3101/:3113 does not repaint native Finder keys. Repaint alone also cannot fix the missing horizontal reveal at finder_windows.c:2207-2213. Deliver the damage through the normal update/present spine and reveal the selected icon in both axes using actual viewport geometry. Ground truth: PRD 6.3; ../system7-decomp/specs/toolbox/window-manager.md:236-265 damage/update contract; spec/flair_finder_alerts_trace.mk:10-14 keyboard contract. Immediate feedback/two-axis visibility are authored usability requirements from desktop REPORT.md L002/L003, not a measured historical Mac trace. Acceptance: extend test-finder-limits/test-finder-windows with independent expected selection and viewport cases; add/extend the test-flair-finder-limits emulator leg to grade pixels immediately after arrows/type-ahead/Shift before mouse input, clock update or Ctrl-O, then prove Ctrl-O targets the painted selection. Independently force repaint in a 100-pixel-wide view and verify horizontal reveal, scroll-bar agreement, leftward recovery and existing vertical behavior. Mutants: suppress post-key paint/present while keeping selection; independently restore vertical-only reveal. Both must fail their named pixel/geometry legs; FINDER_MUT_NO_KEYS alone is insufficient. Require locked record-flair GIF/MP4 and applicable Bochs regressions. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-desktop/shots/130-key-before-A.png, shots/131-key-right-stale-A.png, shots/132-key-opens-B.png, shots/133-narrow-many-before.png, shots/134-key-hidden-after-repaint.png, shots/135-key-hidden-revealed.png, shots/repro-key-stale.png, shots/repro-key-hidden.png; evidence/verification-metrics.json, evidence/keys01-serial.log, evidence/keyboard-repro-serial.log, evidence/reproduce_keyboard.py (all abbreviated paths share that audit directory). Coordinate initech-tdnl.80 scrollbar work; do not absorb paging or label-clipping features.

title: Add executable launching to Finder File Open and Ctrl-O
description: Source @3e44338f53906c23e54fc747a3d689a5d7e0ee2a: os/flair/finder_windows.c:2088-2095 marks only selected folders openable and :1865-1883 opens only folders; os/milton/kmain.c:6305-6307 therefore finds Open disabled for an executable-only selection. The real application launch branch exists at kmain.c:3982-3984 through flair_live_launch_app at :3127-3132 but has no menu/keyboard command adapter. F: this entry point was never built despite working double-click launch. Connect executable Open through the shared command spine and existing launch/lifecycle/error path; enabling the row alone is insufficient. Ground truth: PRD 1.4/6.5; ADR-0013; docs/design/GUI-remediation-R3-finder-design.md F4.4 command spine; ../system7-decomp/specs/toolbox/menu-manager.md; audit REPORT.md L004's authored command/double-click consistency requirement and successful CTENANT control. Acceptance: extend test-finder-menu/test-finder-windows and command adapter coverage for app enablement, folders, mixed selections and unsupported documents; extend test-flair-app-launch with separate File Open, Ctrl-O and double-click CTENANT.EXE legs proving exactly one registration/foreground change, usable Quit/return and visible second-resident-slot refusal. Snapshot identities before focus-changing launches. Mutants independently omit app enablement and the command-to-launch adapter; each must fail its named emulator/host leg. Retain existing launch mutants and applicable Bochs app-launch coverage; lock and record the GUI trace through record-flair GIF/MP4. Evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-desktop/shots/150-app-open-menu.png, shots/151-app-command-open.png, shots/152-app-double-click.png, evidence/menus-serial.log, evidence/menus-session.json (abbreviated paths share that audit directory). Ordinary document association is a separate older feature.

title: Correct the TPS manual's shipped exit-to-DOS procedure
description: DOC. Source @3e44338f53906c23e54fc747a3d689a5d7e0ee2a: pubs/manuals/tps-report-generator/s2-leaving-flair.tex:71-73 falsely assumes no AUTOEXEC.BAT and :86-91 requires absent date/time responses; :29 and step references also need alignment. Makefile:10406-10408/:10433 ships AUTOEXEC.BAT containing @ECHO OFF and PATH=A:\DOS; os/milton/command.c:4782-4797 correctly prompts only when AUTOEXEC is absent. Ground truth: shipped image recipe and extracted docs/audits/2026-10-23-desktop/evidence/shipped-AUTOEXEC.BAT; pubs/manuals/tps-report-generator/screens/SCREENS:3-8 already documents the real shipped journey and skipped prompts, and screens/tpsdir.keys:1 starts with CLS. Make TPS-P-01 proceed from the banner directly to A:\>, CLS and CD APPS; explain date/time prompts conditionally for installations without AUTOEXEC and update objectives/cross-references. Acceptance: test-pubs-tps, test-pubs-screens and test-flair-exit-to-dos; add a procedure-contract leg comparing printed expected responses with a locked emulator transcript from the actual shipped volume, since existing screenshot/inventory gates miss contradictory prose. Mutant: restore the unconditional no-AUTOEXEC premise/date response in an isolated manual copy; that same contract leg must fail with a named mismatch. Keep a no-AUTOEXEC control for the conditional prompts; no kernel behavior change.
